answer.rationale: The incumbent will not reopen price and the mandated 18% spend reduction makes renewal unlikely to satisfy the economic requirement. Prior low-cost-vendor experience supports evaluating a primary switch, but the 14-day expiry and 94% line utilization make uninterrupted supply the critical unresolved risk. Verify the prior vendor onboarding and incumbent stability records before committing; any switch should be tightly guarded rather than treated as a broad rollout.
